description:
Update a time block (title, duration, anchor, note, done). Only send fields you want to change. The block keeps its position in the timeline order.

Marking a block done records when it actually happened: it ends now and starts its planned duration earlier (never before the previous done block ended). In the app, a done block then stays at that time in the past of the day, while what is left to do stacks from the current time. A block with a fixed time keeps its hour.

anchor_time.description: Fixed wall-clock hour HH:MM. Pass null to unpin (the block flows with the rest again).

done.description: Mark the block done (true) or not done (false)

note.description: Free note. Pass null to clear.

name: update_day_block
